import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import re
import csv

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")


# Clean and preprocess text (lowercase, remove punctuation)
def clean_text(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", text)
    return text


train_df["clean_text"] = train_df["text"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["clean_text"] = test_df["text"].apply(clean_text)

# Character n-gram feature extraction
vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    lowercase=False,
    ngram_range=(2, 4),
    max_df=0.8,
    min_df=5,
    stop_words=None,
)

X_train_raw = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["clean_text"])
X_test_raw = vectorizer.transform(test_df["clean_text"])

# One-hot encode author labels
label_encoder = {"EAP": [0], "HPL": [1], "MWS": [2]}
y_train = train_df["author"].map(lambda x: label_encoder[x]).values.astype(int)
y_test = None

# Split data into train/validation
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Model pipeline
model = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "clf",
            LogisticRegression(
                max_iter=1000, multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs"
            ),
        )
    ]
)

# Train model
model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Predict on validation set
y_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
y_true_encoded = y_val.values
log_score = log_loss(y_true_encoded, y_pred_proba)

print(f"Validation Log Loss: {log_score:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
y_test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test_raw)

# Save submission
submission_data = sample_submission[["id"]].copy()
submission_data.columns = ["id", "class_id"]

output_columns = [c for c in submission_data.columns if c != "class_id"] + [
    "EAP",
    "HPL",
    "MWS",
]
submission_data.columns = output_columns

# Map class IDs to author names
submission_data["EAP"] = submission_data["class_id"] * y_test_proba[:, 0]
submission_data["HPL"] = submission_data["class_id"] * y_test_proba[:, 1]
submission_data["MWS"] = submission_data["class_id"] * y_test_proba[:, 2]

# Normalize probabilities for each row
for row in submission_data.iterrows():
    probs = row[1].iloc[3:]
    total = sum(probs)
    if total > 0:
        submission_data.loc[row.name, ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]] = probs / total

submission_df = submission_data[["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]]
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
